name: promo-code-cta
title: Promo code CTA
description: A limited offer with its code ready to copy, the terms in plain words and the date it ends, so the discount is one click from the cart.
docs: Pass title, code, endsAt and terms, and optionally a description and an action: a real code, a real date and a link to the terms are what make the urgency honest. endsAt is a time with its offset or a Z, or a plain day that ends with that day on the clocks of timeZone; it is written with locale and the zone's name inside a time element. No timer runs. Once the end has passed the band reads This offer has ended and the code is no longer in the page. A page that is built once corrects itself in the browser; pass now, the same on the server and in the browser, when you render per request so the first paint is already right. The code is a copy field that says Copied in words. labels translates every fixed word.
